name: New Stratus Energy Inc.
summary: New Stratus Energy Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of properties for producing oil and gas, principally in South America. The company's principal mineral properties are located in Colombia. It also holds properties located in Ecuador, Mexico, and Peru. The company was formerly known as Red Rock Energy Inc. and changed its name to New Stratus Energy Inc. in August 2017. New Stratus Energy Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
